title: Toilet Paper Stand 27-Inch Solid Brass Euro Style | Polished Nickel | Carolina | Allied Brass
description:
Need a toilet paper stand when you don’t want a wall installation? This freestanding toilet paper holder (also called a toilet paper stand or toilet tissue stand) keeps a roll ready beside the toilet—ideal for bathrooms where wall space is limited in Polished Nickel, which offers a softer, warmer alternative to chrome with a subtle golden undertone that suits transitional spaces.

Highlights:
- Polished Nickel coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Stay stable on the floor; heavy base helps prevent tipping
- Coordinate classic bath accessories; Carolina Collection piece for matching Carolina with other traditional bathroom hardware
- Built from brass construction; crafted of solid brass materials

Specs & Details:
- Product type: Freestanding / floor toilet paper holder, toilet paper stand, toilet tissue stand
- Material: Solid brass (brass construction)
- Mounting: No wall mount needed (not wall-mounted; floor standing)
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 8 in. x 27 in. x 6 in.
- Shipping weight: 5.6 lbs
- Assembly: Some assembly required
Multiple designer finish options available
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
